description:
Does Cracking Knuckles Really Hurt Your Bones?! — POP! Every time you crack your knuckles, are your finger bones actually snapping?!
Kids science answer for "what happens when you crack knuckles for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

The loud pop comes from tiny harmless gas bubbles snapping inside joint fluid—not bones grinding—and research shows it does not cause arthritis.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
